Ezekiel Pizza
By: Renée DeLano
Published: Friday, January 1, 2010 - 10:51am

Ingredients




1 Ezekiel Wrap
1 Fresh Sliced Tomato
Extra Virgin Olive

ounce A few  of Shredded Low Fat Mozzarella
Grated Cheese to taste

Preparation

1 Place sliced tomato on wrap add some extra virgin Olive Oil, Low Fat Mozzarella, Grated Cheese and Toast in Oven until bubbly.

About


This is a super quick recipe that replaces high fat/high calorie pizzeria pizza. You can use any wrap of your choice, there are so many to choose from. I used Ezekiel Wraps, added a whole sliced tomato, a little extra virgin olive oil, grated cheese and some low fat mozzarella. Toasted in the oven, with some roasted chicken on the side & a small salad! A perfect Friday Night Pizza Fix!
